title: Idle previews and abandoned temporary stacks stop; active work and installed services keep running
description: Runs the idle stack cleanup regression over a controlled container inventory and clock: a preview unused for 30 minutes and a temporary stack whose owner is gone are stopped with docker stop, keeping their volumes, while an opened preview, one under review, a live trial's stack, the installed server and database, foreign and unlabelled containers and the shared builder keep running; repeating it stops nothing; the stop is logged and recorded on the item with its last use; opening the stopped preview's link restarts it; and after a loop restart cleanup resumes without touching a live trial.
